summary: Two independent R3 reviews agree that v25 fixes the v24 publication, logical poison, sealing and runtime-policy direction, but still lacks complete PIT event lifecycles, confuses post-cutoff known clocks with null clocks, can abandon a valid multi-event run, has no claim-to-outcome lease and crash terminal, does not close the staging seal/publication order, and leaves the M7 V2 qualification, Gate capability, screening prerequisites, CCC numeric semantics and stage-owned test responsibilities incomplete.

limitations: Both reviewers were read-only and did not edit design, product, test, gate or ledger files.
Neither reviewer invoked quality_ledger or ran replay, training, real data, PIT certification, budget consumption or final-OOS access.
